detailed_description: The PDF Splitter extracts pages from a PDF in your browser. It uses PDF.js to show page thumbnails and pdf-lib to copy selected pages into a new PDF. You can choose specific pages from the thumbnail grid, enter a continuous page range, or split every page into its own one-page PDF packaged as a ZIP file. This is useful for saving just the pages you need, separating forms or receipts from a larger scan, or creating individual page files for review.
usage_steps: Click the upload area and choose a PDF file from your device
Wait for the page thumbnails to load in the browser
Choose Selected Pages, Page Range, or Each Page Separately
Select pages from the thumbnail grid or enter the range start and end
Click Split PDF to create the extracted PDF or ZIP file
Download the generated file when processing finishes
usage_examples: Extract a few useful pages from a long PDF manual
Save a page range from a report as a separate PDF
Split scanned receipts into one PDF per page for filing
Create a ZIP of individual page PDFs for separate review
